label: confirm ignored, the plan always writes (.withoutConfirmNothingIsWritten)
find: guard let write = linkToMake(plan, confirmed: confirm) else
replace: guard let write = linkToMake(plan, confirmed: true) else

label: a failed write reported as linked (.aFailedWriteIsARefusal)
find: return result(.refuse(reason: "Couldn't make the link at \(write.at): \(error)"))

label: already linked reported as not in place (.ourOwnLinkIsAlreadyLinked)
find: case .alreadyLinked(let at): InstallResult(plan: "alreadyLinked", at: at, to: nil, reason: nil, linked: true)
replace: case .alreadyLinked(let at): InstallResult(plan: "alreadyLinked", at: at, to: nil, reason: nil, linked: false)

label: a plain file reads as nothing there (.aPlainFileIsItsOwnTarget)
